description: Look up official document types, committees, parties, constituencies, speech reply filters, sessions, identifier conventions and source coverage. The offline snapshot is dated; follow nextCall to read every entry. Document subtypes remain distinct from parent document-type codes, and the session catalog can lag current sessions.

limit.description: Requested entries; values above 100 are clamped with a notice.

topic.description: Vocabulary or guidance topic to browse.

name: riksdag_list_reference

effectiveQuery.description: Deterministic normalized input, applied defaults and local filters.

entries.description: Complete entries on this page, retaining Swedish source labels and distinct subtypes.

items.description: One official vocabulary entry or documented source convention.

code.description: Official filter code, or the documented convention identifier.

end.description: Published session end with original date/time precision.

explanation.description: Published description or explicit server guidance for this convention.

labelEn.description: Available English label published by the source, without invented translation.

labelSv.description: Swedish source label; explanatory guidance has Swedish topic labels.

seriesCode.description: Published series code, preserving leading zeros.

sessionId.description: Source session identifier, distinct from the public session string.

sourceType.description: Original typ value in the document catalog.

start.description: Published session start with original date/time precision.

subtype.description: Document subtype, distinct from the parent document-type code; empty means parent row.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Applied maximum page length after clamping and whole-entry fitting.

args.description: Complete arguments for the next reference page.

toolName.description: Tool to retrieve the next page.

notices.description: All applicable notices, including an empty list.

items.description: A source limitation, applied bound or next-step notice.

referenceCatalogTimestamp.description: Original catalog generation timestamp without an inferred timezone.

referenceSourceUrl.description: Official source URL for this topic.

retrievedAt.description: Source fetch time, retained unchanged on cache hits.

source.description: Required attribution to the Swedish Parliament.

totalCount.description: Exact number of bundled entries for this topic.

truncated.description: Whether response fitting shortened this page.

upstreamQuery.description: Upstream query echo; not proof that a filter was applied.

title: Riksdag List Reference
